title: RNA-Seq in vivo BA 10mg Chow Diet
author: N.G Martin, Hugo
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Isolate total cellular RNA
steps.instruction: Extract cellular RNA using the RNeasy® Mini Kit (Qiagen, catalog 74104) following the kit protocol.

steps.title: Evaluate RNA quality and quantity
steps.instruction: Analyze and quantify the isolated RNA with an Agilent Bioanalyzer.

steps.title: Set RNA input for library prep
steps.instruction: Take 200 ng of total RNA to use as input for library preparation.

steps.title: Prepare RNA-Seq libraries
steps.instruction: Construct libraries using the NEBNext Ultra II RNA Library Prep Kit (New England Biolabs GmbH, Germany) according to the manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Assess library quality
steps.instruction: Measure the quantity and quality of the prepared libraries using an Agilent BioAnalyzer.

steps.title: Sequence libraries on NovaSeq
steps.instruction: Sequence the libraries on an Illumina NovaSeq instrument, aiming for approximately 35 million paired‑end 100 bp reads per library.
